sites.name: Ancient Oak Root Hollow (Oak Hollow #4)
sites.description: A sheltered 40x40cm quadrant nestled within the exposed basal roots of an English Oak. Synthetic demonstration dataset showing simulated fungal fruiting.

sites.name: Richmond Park Beech Bark Fissure

sites.name: Granite Boulder Bryophyte Study
sites.description: Longitudinal micro-habitat study tracking natural bryophyte coverage and hydration dynamics across a 14-day sequence on a north-facing granite rock face using authentic handheld photography.
